name: IntegrateIT Client for the ESPHome Native API
notes: Local Control4 client for a single ESPHome device over its Native API (TCP :6053, plaintext protobuf). Enumerates the device's switch, binary_sensor, sensor, text_sensor, cover, and light entities, maps up to eight of them into labeled Control4 slots with typed variables and Changed events, and drives switches and lights On/Off/Toggle, light brightness 0-100%, and covers Open/Close/Stop/Set Position. Capability-honest: brightness and position are refused by name on entities that report they do not support them. Plaintext + legacy password auth only. MAC-locked IntegrateIT licensing.
